description: Phase 09 Addendum Prompt 01 — memory candidate preview. A read-only, advisory surface that identifies possible long-term memory candidates from already-redacted, already-source-linked, guard-clean local records (system/config facts, repeated operator preferences, stable redacted project read models). It NEVER accepts or persists accepted memory: every surfaced candidate is review_status='pending_review' and never auto-accepted. Inputs are rejected when unsourced, raw-content-shaped, or implying a final determination; review tier 3 inputs are surfaced only as non-acceptance preview (a future acceptance-mode caller rejects tier 3). Deterministic: candidate identity/content is hash-derived. Evidence is metadata-only (statement hashes + source_ref hashes; no statement text, no source_ref).
